name: Production sampler regression
purpose: Preserve canonical Moon sampled output after LOS/record-format corrections.
production_capability: Full canonical test_Moon build/run and output comparison.
configuration: Canonical test_Moon configuration and registered processor count.
inputs: bundled user-reviewed corrected-Na four-rank reference and provenance
independent_reference: Reviewed production regression reference, used only because no first-principles oracle covers the complete sampled file; linked lifetime/survival and budget identities separately verify the Na correction.
procedure: Run make -j test_Moon, verify the bundled reviewed four-rank reference and provenance hashes through check_reference.py, and inspect test_Moon.diff. The 2026-11-12 user-approved replacement follows two identical corrected-Na production runs and linked survival/budget checks; the prior SWMF_data revision 7a1c437 reference is archived unchanged under reference/superseded.
acceptance_criteria: test_Moon.diff exists and is exactly zero bytes.
status_semantics: PASS is regression agreement; missing reference/build output is ERROR, not SKIPPED or PASS.
